_note: Model settings v0.1, fixed on 10 Nov 2026 before any forecast. Stability band = the move (in %) under which a change counts as 'stable'. Each band is the 33rd percentile of absolute moves, so about one period in three is stable. Computed on Drewry weekly 2019-2026 excluding the Covid regime (Jul 2020 - Jun 2022), and on EC same-contract daily settlements since Aug 2023. Rounded to 0.5 point. Recomputed at most once a quarter, and every change is logged.
